title: Contribution record
description: One file per contribution: community/contributions/C<number>.json. A contribution is a proposal with evidence and a validation plan. `python3 scripts/community.py check` validates every record against this schema and adds the rules a schema cannot express: the file is named after the id, no text holds raw HTML, every link is a plain https address; and the rules for acceptance: an accepted contribution needs a pinned baseline and implementation, every required check passed on that exact revision, named reviewers who approved it, and an answer to every objection.

issue.description: The issue in this repository where the contribution is discussed, or null.

class.description: What the contribution is. import-fix, linking-repair and re-declaration can enter the patched release. variant, model and mapping stand beside the provider's numbers under their own name.

baseline.description: The provider release and the import the contribution builds on.

layer.description: The implementation, pinned to a revision.

file.description: For a contribution that changes the inventory: the file that states its changes, from which the release build makes a database of its own beside the patched release. Null or absent for any other contribution.

upstream_project.description: The project that owns the decision.
